sources.entry: Stargazer Bar - Track one public GitHub repo's stars and release downloads from the menu bar.

summary.one_liner: A small native macOS menu bar app that shows GitHub star counts, release download totals, and maintainer activity for public and private repositories.
summary.what_it_does: Stargazer Bar sits in the macOS menu bar and displays live star counts for multiple public GitHub repositories, with a headline number in the bar and detail in the dropdown. For private repositories, it tracks maintainer signals such as CI status, recent commits, new pull requests and issues, and unanswered issues, along with a 30-day commit chart across branches. It totals release downloads from GitHub's latest releases API (up to 100 releases) and shows per-repo star and fork trend charts. It can copy milestone text or a share image when a repo crosses a rounded download or star mark. The app reads GitHub directly with no backend; tracked repo metadata and settings are kept in UserDefaults, and optional OAuth tokens in Keychain.
use_cases: monitor GitHub star count from the menu bar
track release download totals for a project
watch CI status and new issues on private repos
share a milestone image when a repo hits a star goal
track stars of a repo you do not own
how_to_run: Or download the signed, notarized Apple silicon DMG from the latest GitHub release
notable: Tracks private repos by what needs attention (failing builds, unanswered issues, new PRs) rather than stars
No backend and no telemetry; only non-GitHub network call is optional Sparkle update checks
Apple silicon native app with signed, notarized builds
Release helper scripts handle signing, notarization, appcast generation, and Homebrew cask update
caveats: Direct download is for Apple silicon only
Signed-in repository picker requires the maintainer's own GitHub OAuth app client id to be configured
Private repo tracking needs a read-only fine-grained GitHub token
Release download totals only cover the latest 100 releases
keywords: see how many people downloaded my release
